answer_2.quote: We mainly adopt metrics used in retrieval tasks to measure LCLMs, including recall and precision... We first use exact match (EM) to measure each line... we calculate recall and precision based on EM, acquiring EM-R and EM-P... we calculate the longest common subsequence (LCS) ... we use CodeBLEU... we employ BLEU for evaluation...

answer_4.quote: We measure the consistency between our metrics and human evaluation by selecting 20 GPT-4o outputs on each task and inviting two advanced developers to manually evaluate them. Using τ, we found that the average τ value is at least 0.75 across all tasks...
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators manually evaluated model outputs for consistency with the automatic metrics.
